tools.name: get_my_next_step
tools.description: Use when the signed-in WorkforceAP member asks what to do next. Returns the member's highest-priority saved next step. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: get_training_status
tools.description: Use when the signed-in WorkforceAP member asks about their assigned program, validated training progress, approved-curriculum applicability, or whether mapped Coursera content is operationally available. Treat approved curriculum as assigned only when appliesToEnrollment is true and enrollmentVersionMatch is match; otherwise use enrollment/progress fields only. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: get_coursera_progress
tools.description: Use when the signed-in WorkforceAP member asks about course-level Coursera progress synchronized into WorkforceAP. This is synchronized portal data, not a live Coursera API response. Takes no arguments.
